text:
Olivia (People Ops): Idea: tiny pop-up "Thank-you Mailbox" — a decorated mailbox in the lobby where people drop short thank-you notes and volunteers add a spot-award sticker + QR to log it. low-cost, anonymous option for shy teams. anyone have concerns? :mailbox_with_mail:
Marcus (Security): sounds sweet. only ask: don't collect personal addresses or sensitive content. keep it internal and anonymous.
Hannah (Finance): cost check? stickers + mailbox prop + signage. if under $400 fine from GL 4102. Also reminder: any physical token per person should be recorded in recognition portal if manager wants credit.
Olivia (People Ops): plan: one mailbox prop, 500 stickers, table + QR placard linking to quick form. budget estimate $260 (prop $60, stickers $120, signage $30, misc $50).
Rosa (Facilities): I can reserve a corner of the lobby for June 20-24 and handle table + power. need to ensure no obstruction to fire exits.
Talia (Design): I can mock a 1-sided sign that says: "Drop a note. Want a sticker? Scan QR + submit shorthand kudos; volunteers will add a sticker to your recipient's token." Keep it playful.
kudos-bot: Reminder — please log any spot-awards via /recognize with tag #mailbox-thanks so they appear in monthly exports.
Olivia (People Ops): process idea: 1) people drop notes (anonymous or named). 2) volunteers open notes hourly, check if a recipient is named; if yes volunteer scans QR and submits quick form linking recipient + short quote and adds a sticker to the recipient card. 3) if anonymous, volunteers put note on a community board.
Marcus (Security): ensure volunteers are trained to avoid opening notes with sensitive info. put a front-line sign: "Don't write passwords, personal info, or medical details."
Hannah (Finance): tax note: physical stickers < $10/year per person are non-taxable but must be tracked. portal will tally annual totals and flag if anyone crosses $100.
Olivia (People Ops): volunteers? need 2 per day for the pop-up week. slots 11-1 and 1-3. can we get coverage?
Rosa (Facilities): I can staff Monday 11-1 and Friday 1-3 to help set up/teardown.
Talia (Design): I can do Tuesday 1-3 and I'll bring a pen kit and pre-printed recipient cards to speed things up.
Hannah (Finance): I'll take Wednesday 11-1 to QA the tracking sheet and make sure entries reconcile with spend.
Olivia (People Ops): great — one open slot Thursday 11-1. I'll post sign-up in the channel. action items: Talia final sign, Rosa reserve space, Hannah confirm petty spend path, Olivia order 500 stickers and mailbox prop, kudos-bot link QR to form.
kudos-bot: Note — entries tagged #mailbox-thanks will be visible in the June recognition export.
Marcus (Security): small privacy blurb required on the form: "Notes are visible to volunteers and used only for internal recognition. Do not include private or sensitive info."
Olivia (People Ops): adding opt-out and anonymity options on the form. also we'll include a line: "Is this for an employee award? toggle yes/no; if yes we'll collect recipient name and manager for tracking."
Hannah (Finance): confirm: please upload receipts to Concur within 5 business days; GL 4102. If total spend exceeds $500 we'll need /spend-approval before ordering.
Olivia (People Ops): budget looks under $500 — I'll proceed but won't place order until Hannah confirms petty route.
Rosa (Facilities): large sign placement noted; accessibility: mailbox height < 36in for reachability or have a lower slot.
Talia (Design): will include an accessibility friendly layout and an alternative drop-box seat-level slot.
Olivia (People Ops): perfect. tiny reminder: payroll cutoff June 30 for recognition entries to be included this cycle. please tag and submit quickly if you want manager credit.
Hannah (Finance): acknowledged.
Olivia (People Ops): thanks team — excited for low-effort, high-feel culture win. :sparkles:
